answer: Admit new agents through a cultivation garden: each fresh address completes paid trial services with randomly assigned incumbent mentors before earning full privileges. Every session yields a quill entry, a signed tamper-evident log, and unproven addresses pay saffron-tier premium rates until their logs check out. Mentors are paid per session and never serve the same owner twice, so each fake identity needs its own garden of distinct paid sessions, costing N full admissions with no bulk discount, while an honest agent plants once.
